title: GET /status returns 200 ok without X-Secret-Key
oracle: Isolation: wrong/missing secret must not get 200 on /status (body must not be ok)
vector: GET http://127.0.0.1:3000/status with no X-Secret-Key header
evidence: Long query string without secret → 200 ok
Route wiring: crates/goose/src/acp/transport/mod.rs .route("/status", get(health)) without auth middleware
notes: Contrast: GET /acp without secret correctly returns 401. /health is also public (200 ok) but SCOPE isolation oracle names /status.

title: GET /status returns 200 ok with wrong X-Secret-Key
oracle: Isolation: wrong/missing secret must not get 200 on /status (body must not be ok)
vector: GET /status with X-Secret-Key: wrong-secret-value (also emoji/unicode wrong values)
evidence: X-Secret-Key: wrong + Accept SSE on /acp → 401 (ACP enforces; /status does not)
notes: Invalid secrets are treated the same as the valid local key for /status.

title: GET /status returns 200 ok with empty X-Secret-Key
oracle: Isolation: wrong/missing secret must not get 200 on /status (body must not be ok)
notes: Empty secret is not rejected on the protected /status surface defined by SCOPE.

title: GET /status returns 200 ok with 10KB X-Secret-Key
oracle: Isolation: wrong/missing secret must not get 200 on /status (body must not be ok)
vector: GET /status with X-Secret-Key set to 10240 'A' characters
expected: Non-200 (e.g. 401/403) or body not 'ok'; server remains healthy
notes: Oversized invalid secret is accepted for /status (same auth bypass class as ISO-001–003).
